summary.headline: Security update status dashboard and Configuration Manager console update guidance are added
summary.overview: Microsoft adds an Intune security update status dashboard article and a Configuration Manager Console Extension security-update article.
summary.adminImpact: Security and Configuration Manager teams should review the new dashboard and console update material as part of servicing and reporting routines.

keyChanges.title: Security update status dashboard guidance is added

keyChanges.title: Configuration Manager Console Extension security-update guidance is added

summary.headline: STIG audit-baseline compliance guidance is added
summary.overview: Microsoft adds guidance for using Security Technical Implementation Guide audit baselines to assess Windows device compliance and updates the security-baselines overview.
summary.adminImpact: Organizations using STIG controls should evaluate the new audit-baseline guidance before incorporating it into Windows compliance assessment.

keyChanges.title: STIG audit-baseline compliance guidance is added
keyChanges.detail: Microsoft published a guide for using STIG audit baselines to assess Windows device compliance in Intune.

keyChanges.title: Security baselines overview is updated

summary.headline: Android Management API support for personal work profiles is documented
summary.overview: The day adds an Android Management API overview for personally owned work profiles and updates Android Enterprise compliance and enrollment guidance.
summary.adminImpact: Android enterprise teams should assess the new API material and validate personal work-profile enrollment procedures against current documentation.

keyChanges.title: Android Management API work-profile guidance is added

summary.headline: Windows Autopilot known-issues and release information is refreshed
summary.overview: Microsoft updates the Windows Autopilot known-issues and What's new references alongside the Intune What's new index.
summary.adminImpact: Autopilot deployment teams should review the current known issues and release changes before rollout or troubleshooting.

summary.adminImpact: Security teams should assess the STIG material, apply console security servicing as appropriate, and factor current Autopilot known issues into rollout planning.
